summary:
Two flat-topped west towers (x 2..22, top y 95, parapet to 97), then nave and choir (clerestory eave y 47) under one continuous lead ridge at y 59, transept roses north and south, an octagonal deepslate spire at the crossing with copper apostles and its rooster tip at exactly y 137.
It reads as Notre-Dame from the river: a semicircular east end (apse) ringed by five gabled chapels, buttress piers standing 3 blocks proud with pinnacles, and long one-block flying buttresses with open sky under them.
Pale cream sandstone against dark lead roofs, deep window reveals with lit stained glass, and floodlights at the pier feet for dusk; every mass stays within the footprint and height limits. Notre-Dame from the river: pale smooth/cut sandstone cathedral with flat-topped west towers (y 95-97), one continuous lead nave+choir roof (ridge 59) and transept roses, a hand-built half-decagon apse with five gabled radiating chapels. The relief is the hero: 3-proud set-off piers with pinnacles, 30 one-block flying buttresses with sky under them, gargoyles, corbel tables and parapets on the south flank and chevet.
An octagonal deepslate spire with copper apostles ends in the rooster at (94,137,38); stained glass glows from shroomlights behind it, ochre froglight floodlights sit at the pier feet and lanterns stand on the set-offs for dusk.
elements: P4 Flanks, transept faces and chevet relief (parts/relief.mjs)

summary: P1 Masonry shell: P1 masonry shell built in parts/shell.mjs and make.sh writes a whole build.nbt (103,657 blocks). It contains: hollow west towers with floors at y 30/57/62 and belfry frames on all four faces, the porch base with three portal voids, the west rose frame, and the M4 gable (peak 63). It also has the flankBay rhythm on both flanks of the nave and choir, the transept with rose frames, triforium lancets and stone gables (peak 57), and the apse polygon. The rest: the ambulatory rings, five chapels, all 24 flank piers, the 6 radial piers, the transept and west buttresses, the sacristy, the stair turret, and plinths down to the GROUND map. Openings and RESERVED cells are left as unwritten air.
polish: Apse clerestory windows (5 facets, y 38..45) and the ambulatory tribune lancets are plain air: no jambs, sill or head. P4 may want to frame them.
The 3x3 gable roses (y 51..53) are kept as air holes inside the stone gables, but the stoneGable rake could be clipped there. P4 should check them.
Orphan check: 4 single smooth_sandstone_stairs (lancet heads at 30,16,66 and on the chevet chapels near 175,16,20/54/56) sit with one face touching. Minor.
The nave's last bay (x 80..84) is plain wall with no windows, and the first nave bay window is at x 27..30, not 25..28. Both are noted in plan.md Notes.
Tower clasping corner buttresses (+1 to y 93) are not built. The towers are plain hollow boxes with a stepped corner at z 10..11 / 65..66.
Sacristy gable ends are left to P2's roof tool. Sacristy buttresses stop at z 109 (z 110 is outside the footprint).
fit and full render review were only glanced at (front-right iso and south elevation), not checked in detail.

summary: P2 Lead roofs: P2 is built: all the cathedral's lead roofs are in parts/roofs.mjs. The nave+choir roof and the transept roof are one surface with valleys where they cross, built by hand at 1:1 pitch from eave y 48 to ridges 59/57, with iron_bars crests at y 60/58. The spire box is left open for P5, and the 12 apostle stations sit on full tiles. The apse has its hipped half-cone and cross; the tribune and aisle lean-tos run straight along the flanks and round the apse; the five chapels have their gables and pinnacles; both towers have flat decks at y 95; the sacristy has three gable roofs and the stair turret has its cone. make.sh: P2 placed 18927 blocks with 0 refused and 0 off-palette; check shows 0 floating blocks and none of the orphans it lists are P2's (they belong to the shell and the ground). In the render the roofs read as steep dark lead over the cream stone.
polish: I didn't write roof.json: R1, R2 and R8 are built by hand, so runParts prints 'roof: skipped'. That is expected, not an error.

P5: the apostle stations' cells under the feet are already deepslate_tiles, so call apostle with replaceBelow:false or it will be refused. The spire box x 90..98 z 34..42 y>=48 is open, with a tile course 2 cells down around it for the drum to close against.

P4: I left the wall-buttress cells clear (x p..p+1, z 50/26, y 37..47) and the apse vertex-buttress cells (within 1.6 of each vertex, y>=37). Under the flyers at z 51..54 there are only 3 cells of sky over the tribune lean-to (its top is y 37), not the 4 the plan asks for; this is noted in plan.md.
The sacristy west wing uses a half pitch in slabs (ridge y 17); 1:1 would have pushed it to y 22. The gallery is 1:1 with its ridge at y 16.

summary: P3 West front and towers: I built the West front and towers part in parts/westfront.mjs. It adds the three portals with dark_oak door pairs and a trumeau, 28 king statues, string courses at y 21/22/29, and a stained-glass west rose set one block back (x 3). It also adds blind lancets standing out from the tower faces, the Grand Gallery colonnade, the chimera balustrade with 8 gargoyles, hanging lanterns, and tower parapets at y 96–97 with 2x2 corner pinnacles that stop at y 97. make.sh finishes with 2660 blocks placed for this part, no refused writes and no off-palette blocks. `mcd check` shows nothing floating or unsupported in this part's cells, and zoom renders of the facade and tower tops read correctly.
polish: The tower blind lancets stick out 1 block (a frame at x 1) instead of being recessed, because P1 left the wall solid there. A recessed version needs P1 to leave holes at x 2, z 15..17/23..25/51..53/59..61, y 32..45.
The Grand Gallery runs z 12..64, not 10..66: z 65..66 at x 2 is outside the footprint, and z 10..11 is the tower's stepped corner.
The belfry louvres and black panes were already placed by P1's belfryLancet call, which does both frame and fill. I ticked the element but placed none of those blocks myself.
Because P1's portal call uses rings 5, the outer archivolt plane reaches about y 24, which may take a few Gallery of Kings cells above the central portal. Those niches give way to the arch.
Not covered by the spec: the tower decks (P2) and the deck lanterns at y 96 (P6).

summary:
P4 Flanks, transept faces and chevet relief: I built parts/relief.mjs. It adds 24 nave and choir flyers that are open arches with sky under them, 6 radial chevet flyers, the apse vertex buttresses, wall buttresses and gargoyles, and pinnacles on all 18 piers and the 4 transept buttresses.
It also adds the aisle and ambulatory string course with the balustrade above, the corbel table, cornice and parapet along the clerestory and round the apse, and the clerestory mullions. The transept faces get their portals with doors, wimpergs, glazed south and north roses and the small gable roses; the 5 chevet chapels get gablets and corner pinnacles.
make.sh: P4 placed 5254 blocks with 0 refused writes and 0 off-palette blocks. mcd check: 0 floating blocks, and no orphan comes from this part.

Gargoyles are only on the nave and choir wall buttresses, none at the apse vertex buttresses.
The chapel gablet is drawn by a local rotated helper, not by vocab `wimperg`. Its open triangle and crockets are simplified: 2 crocket stubs and no end_stone finial.

summary: P5 Spire and apostles: The spire (P5) is built in parts/spire.mjs: a 9-wide octagonal drum (y 48..70) with eight stained-glass lancets, ribs on the corners, gablets over the four main lancets and deepslate_tiles bands every 5 courses. Above it a hollow lead needle narrows 7 → 5 → 3 → 1 wide, with crockets every 3 courses and stepped ledges where it narrows. At the top: cross arms at y 131, an end_rod mast, and the lightning_rod at exactly (94,137,38), the build's highest block. The 12 copper apostles stand on the four roof arms. make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt; my part placed 2198 blocks with no refused writes and no blocks outside the palette.
polish: In this copy the spire and apostles show as FLOATING in the check, because the roof part (P2) is still a stub. The spire is held up only where the R1/R2 roofs meet its base and filled corners at y 48..57, and the apostles stand on P2's roof stairs (feet 1 above the slope). After merging, re-run `$MCD check` to confirm they connect.
Nothing frames the inside of the crossing below y 48 (no stripped_dark_oak_log posts down to the crossing piers): those cells are outside P5's box.
The gablets over the drum's four main lancets stand 1 outside the spire box (x 89/99, z 33/43, y 67..69). This is noted in plan.md's Notes.

summary:
P6 Glass, light and ground: P6 is built in parts/finish.mjs. Glass goes into every window the shell left open: chapels, tribunes, clerestory, transept triforium, apse, tribune ring, radiating chapels and sacristy. A shroomlight sits behind each window and rose, ochre floodlights sit at the south and chevet pier feet and every 6 along the north and west, lanterns stand on the south set-offs, and a light grid plus a smooth_stone strip covers the ground.
make.sh: P6 placed 4511 blocks, 0 refused, 0 off-palette. check: 0 floating, 0 unsupported. light: 0 dark cells inside the footprint at y 3, 16 at y 1-2, upper floors at y 21 / 31 at 7 or more.
polish: The parapet-post lanterns (y 49 and y 21) and the tower-deck lanterns (y 96) only find their spots in P4's balustrades and P2's decks, which are stubs in this copy. Check after the merge that they placed, then run `$MCD light` again for the roof gutters, the aisle walks and the decks.

16 dark cells are left inside the footprint at y 1-2 near the sacristy gallery (x 112..127, z 64..79). About 2700 dark cells lie outside the footprint (the river edge, z 70+), where I'm not allowed to build.
The floodlight '1 out' from a south pier face would be z 70, which is outside the footprint, so the lights sit beside the foot at z 69 (x p-1 and p+2) instead.
The south pier lanterns stand at y 22 on the weathering stair, not at y 21, because setoffPier puts a stair on the y 20 set-off. `$MCD fit` may flag this as on a half block.
The rose glows are set touching the wall ring 7 out from each rose centre. Check after the merge that P3/P4's rose glass (plane x 2 / z 66 / z 10) doesn't leave them floating.
The 189 ORPHAN notes from check are interior shroomlights touching their pane (hidden) and grass at the plot edge. I left them.
